ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel surface (dark grey to black) representing approximately 95% of the total fluke area, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel aggregates totaling roughly 5%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixel clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips (points) of both lobes. Multiple discrete, sub-centimeter circular high-intensity focal points are distributed across the left lobe's mid-section; the remaining surface is a non-uniform low-intensity matte.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated aperture of approximately 50-55 degrees; notch depth penetrates to approximately 18% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-frequency serration along the continuous boundary; irregular saw-tooth profile with peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 3 and 10 pixels, isolated from the high-contrast water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed structure exhibiting a symmetrical concave-to-convex curve transition from the central peduncle to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of dense, high-contrast pixel aggregates (barnacle colonization) at the distal tips; secondary detection of distinct circular white rings (scars) on the central-left lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary detection of a large intersecting diagonal linear disruption (X-shaped) on the right lobe; secondary detection of multiple shorter, unaligned horizontal and vertical linear scratches across the lower mid-sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial linear trauma markings on the right lobe and heavy parasitic/barnacle encrustation on the distal margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, multi-jagged trailing edge profile with non-uniform serration frequency.
